task.description: Hard gate on TEST-DESIGNER's coverage for ISS-0400. TEST-DESIGNER reports a fail-then-pass proof via a throwaway git worktree at main (58e3c64e, pre-ISS-0400): 13/18 passed pre-fix (5 genuine failures matching the exact regression symptom), 18/18 passed post-fix. Do NOT accept this claim as reported -- independently reproduce at least the core discriminating case yourself: create your own throwaway git worktree at main (58e3c64e), copy only the new ISS-0400 test code (or the relevant describe blocks) into that pre-fix tree, run it, and confirm for yourself that it genuinely fails there with the same symptom TEST-DESIGNER reports, then confirm it passes on this branch. This is the standard 'apply the reported evidence yourself' rule for a fail-then-pass regression test (WF-03_issue_resolving.md's Step 4 section) -- accepting the reported pass counts is copying a claim, not validating one. Also verify: every acceptance criterion on step-04-test-designer.json's task block actually has a runnable test backing it (fixtures 1/2/3/3b/4 from design section 4), no skipped/pending coverage, fixtures are self-sufficient (no hidden dependency on test execution order or another test's side effects), and the existing 12 ISS-0398 tests are genuinely unchanged (diff them against main). Clean up any worktree you create when done.
acceptance_criteria: At least one new ISS-0400 test independently re-run by you (not TEST-DESIGNER) against a fresh throwaway worktree at main (58e3c64e), confirmed to genuinely fail there with real quoted output
The same test independently re-run by you against this branch, confirmed to pass with real quoted output
Every one of design section 4's specified fixtures (1, 2, 3, 3b, 4) has a corresponding runnable test, none skipped
Fixtures confirmed self-sufficient (no shared mutable state, no execution-order dependency)
The existing 12 ISS-0398 tests are confirmed byte-identical to main's version (or explain any diff)
Verdict is PASS or FAIL with issues at BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR severity

result.summary: Independently re-derived TEST-DESIGNER's fail-then-pass claim rather than accepting it, and it holds exactly as reported. Diff check: `git diff 58e3c64e -- test/letflow/engine/parallel_gateway_test.exs` shows 357 insertions(+), 0 deletions, 0 modifications -- the existing 12 ISS-0398 tests are confirmed byte-identical to main's version, not merely 'unchanged in spirit'. Own throwaway worktree: `git worktree add ../letflow-2-iss0400-validator-worktree 58e3c64e` (main's pre-fix commit). Copied ONLY this branch's test/letflow/engine/parallel_gateway_test.exs into the worktree (git status --porcelain in the worktree confirmed exactly one file modified, lib/letflow/engine/transition.ex left as pristine pre-fix code). PRE-FIX run (worktree, `mix test test/letflow/engine/parallel_gateway_test.exs`, deps/build reused from the main tree via MIX_DEPS_PATH/MIX_BUILD_PATH since no network access for a second deps.get): self-observed 'Result: 13/18 passed, Failed: 5 tests' -- the same 5 ISS-0400 tests TEST-DESIGNER reported: fixture 1 (both tests), fixture 3, and fixture 4 fail with `right: {:error, {:no_matching_join_found, "outer_split"}}` (exact regression symptom); fixture 3b's negative case fails in the opposite direction with pre-fix code wrongly returning `{:ok, ...}` and a bogus JoinCounter registered under "inner_split" itself -- I read this failure output directly, not copied from TEST-DESIGNER's handoff. POST-FIX run (this branch, HEAD, worktree removed first via `git worktree remove ../letflow-2-iss0400-validator-worktree --force`): self-observed 'Result: 18 passed' -- all 12 original + 6 new tests green. `git worktree list` afterward shows only the main tree -- no residue. Fixture coverage: verified all 5 of design section 4's fixtures (1, 2, 3, 3b, 4) map to runnable, non-skipped tests by reading the test file's 5 new describe blocks directly against design doc lines 743-822 -- fixture 1 gets 2 tests (core regression + runtime-boundary), fixtures 2/3/3b/4 get 1 each, all present, none tagged :skip, no 'TODO: implement test' anywhere in the file (grepped, no matches). No hardcoded secrets/connection strings in the test file (grepped for password/secret/api_key/conn strings, no matches). Self-sufficiency: every fixture is a plain 0-arity function building a fresh %Graph{} literal, no setup/on_exit, no Ecto.Sandbox, async: true (same convention as the 12 ISS-0398 tests); ran the full file at --seed 1 and --seed 99999 (18 passed both times) and ran two ISS-0400 tests in isolation by line number (`mix test ...:892 ...:981`, 'Result: 2 passed, 16 excluded') to confirm no execution-order or cross-test dependency. mix format --check-formatted test/letflow/engine/parallel_gateway_test.exs: exit 0, clean. No gaps found; no rework needed.
